title: VaultUnit backend rewrite

assessment_snapshot.intro: The repository contains a Java 17 / Spring Boot 3.5.6 backend with a file-based H2 database and a React frontend that depends on the API.
bullets: Backend exposes authentication, preferences, dashboard, transactions, community challenges, and money-request endpoints.
Authentication uses Spring Security sessions, BCrypt passwords, and CSRF protection.
An existing H2 database file is present; its preservation or migration policy is not specified.
The backend has an existing authentication test suite; the frontend and backend are started by VS Code tasks.

proposed_outcome: Rewrite the backend at the chosen target location, retaining the agreed API and data behavior, with a verified build, passing backend tests, and a successful startup check. Avoid promising an absolute absence of errors; validate the defined acceptance criteria and report any remaining limitations.
